stem: A transition element is a d-block element which forms one or more stable ions with incomplete d-orbitals.

parts.label: (a)
(b)
parts.text: The $\text{Ni}^{2+}$ ion forms many different complexes. A solution containing the $[\text{Ni}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ complex ion is green. When an excess of 1,2-diaminoethane, $en$, $\text{H}_2\text{NCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{NH}_2$, is added, the colour of the solution changes to blue. This is due to the formation of the $[\text{Ni}(en)_3]^{2+}$ complex ion.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Explain why the two solutions are coloured, and why the colours are different.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The $[\text{Ni}(en)_3]^{2+}$ complex can exist as a mixture of two stereoisomers.

Complete the three-dimensional diagram to show one of the stereoisomers.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}

Each $en$ ligand can be represented using $\text{N}$ $\text{N}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Name the geometry of the complex ion drawn in (b)(ii) and the type of stereoisomerism shown by $[\text{Ni}(en)_3]^{2+}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Iron(II) carbonate, $\text{FeCO}_3$, and nickel(II) carbonate, $\text{NiCO}_3$, both decompose when heated.

$\text{FeCO}_3$ decomposes at a lower temperature than $\text{NiCO}_3$.

Suggest a possible reason for this difference. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
**A** is a pale green salt containing $\text{Fe}^{2+}$ ions. A sample of $2.62\text{ g}$ of **A** is dissolved in water and the solution is made up to exactly $100\text{ cm}^3$ with water. $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ samples of this solution are placed in conical flasks and titrated against $0.0100\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ acidified potassium manganate(VII).

The equation for the only reaction that occurs is shown.

$$5\text{Fe}^{2+} + \text{MnO}_4^- + 8\text{H}^+ \rightarrow 5\text{Fe}^{3+} + \text{Mn}^{2+} + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

The average titre value is $35.0\text{ cm}^3$ of $0.0100\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ acidified potassium manganate(VII).

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Describe the colour change that is seen in the conical flask at the end-point of this titration.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
Calculate the percentage by mass of iron in **A**.

$[A_\text{r}\text{: Fe, 55.8}]$
